grid.expression: WITH TOTALGERAL AS ( SELECT SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS TOTAL FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (:P_GRUPO IS NULL OR GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPO) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR VEN.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) ) SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS TOTAL, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, (SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) / TG.TOTAL) * 100 AS PARTE, (CASE WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 1 THEN 'Linha 1' WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 2 THEN 'Linha 2' ELSE 'Linha N/E' END) AS LINHA FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND CROSS JOIN TOTALGERAL TG WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (:P_GRUPO IS NULL OR GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPO) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR VEN.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) AND (:P_CODPROD IS NULL OR ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, TG.TOTAL, PRO.AD_LINHA

WITH TOTAIS_GERAIS AS ( SELECT SUM(ITE2.QTDNEG) AS TOTAL_QTD, SUM((ITE2.VLRTOT - ITE2.VLRDESC) + NVL(ITE2.AD_VLROUTROS, 0)) AS TOTAL_VALOR FROM TGFITE ITE2 INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB2 ON ITE2.NUNOTA = CAB2.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO2 ON ITE2.CODPROD = PRO2.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU2 ON PRO2.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU2.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN2 ON CAB2.CODVEND = VEN2.CODVEND WHERE TRUNC(CAB2.DTNEG) BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND CAB2.TIPMOV = 'D' AND PRO2.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB2.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB2.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (:P_GRUPO IS NULL OR GRU2.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPO) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB2.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR VEN2.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) AND CAB2.CODTIPOPER IN (1200,1201,1206,1216,1217,1272,2202) ) SELECT PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR, PRO.CODVOL, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTD, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, VEN.CODVEND, VEN.APELIDO, (SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) / NULLIF(TG.TOTAL_QTD, 0)) * 100 AS PARTE, SUM(ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC) AS TOTALLIQ, SUM(NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS, 0)) AS TOTALOUTROS, SUM(ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC) + SUM(NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS, 0)) AS TOTAL, ((SUM(ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC) + SUM(NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS, 0))) / NULLIF(TG.TOTAL_VALOR, 0)) * 100 AS PARTEFATURADO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON PAR.CODCID = CID.CODCID CROSS JOIN TOTAIS_GERAIS TG WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (:P_GRUPO IS NULL OR GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPO) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR VEN.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) AND (:P_CODPROD IS NULL OR ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND (:P_CODUF IS NULL OR CID.UF = :P_CODUF) AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1200,1201,1206,1216,1217,1272,2202) GROUP BY PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR, PRO.CODVOL, PRO.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, VEN.CODVEND, VEN.APELIDO, TG.TOTAL_QTD, TG.TOTAL_VALOR ORDER BY PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR

chart.expression: SELECT GRU.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS TOTAL FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND WHERE CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :P_PER.INI AND :P_PER.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (:P_GRUPO IS NULL OR GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_GRUPO) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (:P_CODVEND IS NULL OR VEN.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) GROUP BY GRU.CODGRUPOPROD, GRU.DESCRGRUPOPROD

SELECT PRO.DESCRPROD, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS TOTAL FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON CAB.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) >= :P_PER.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) <= :P_PER.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :A_CODGRUPOPROD AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND ((:P_CODEMP IS NULL) OR (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP)) AND ((:P_CODVEND IS NULL) OR (VEN.CODVEND = :P_CODVEND)) AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) GROUP BY PRO.DESCRPROD
